calculation.expression: if lag1(share_i(rolling_sum_3d(return_i)<0)) >= 0.75: -rolling_sum_3d(return_i), else null; cross_sectionally median-center
calculation.description: When at least 75% of instruments have negative three-day cumulative returns, rank the lagged three-day reversal signal across the full tradable universe. The breadth regime is lagged one completed day and therefore uses no future data.

validation.regime_notes: Strong aggregate result is conditional and sparse; threshold sensitivity was also positive at 0.67 and 0.80. Results should be interpreted conservatively because only 114 cross-sectional observations were active, despite broad average instrument coverage on active dates.
validation.validation_method: Daily Spearman cross-sectional IC against next-day close-to-close return; only dates with at least 8 valid instruments included.
